### 💡 Codex Review Here are some automated review suggestions for this pull request. **Reviewed commit:** `b75d9e4e61`
ℹ️ About Codex in GitHub
[Your team has set up Codex to review pull requests in this repo](https://chatgpt.com/codex/cloud/settings/general). Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍. Codex can also answer questions or update the PR. Try commenting "@codex address that feedback".

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Verify the HTTP listener belongs to the validated process**

If `rest-port.json` contains the PID of the expected running Proxima process but a port owned by another process, `Get-PxcGateway` accepts it: the CIM checks validate the PID's executable and session, but never establish ownership of the advertised port. Consequently, `models` sends `PROXIMA_API_KEY` to that unrelated listener, and `ask` can also send the user's prompt if the listener advertises the requested model. This affects both local execution and the remote endpoint. Validate the loopback listener's owning PID inside `Get-PxcGateway` before returning its URL, failing closed when ownership cannot be established. Add a counterexample with a valid Proxima PID and a different process's listener, asserting that no HTTP request occurs; preserve valid-listener coverage because ownership queries may require additional permissions.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

Addressed in bc16ccff3601fabeeb783f41b52360ef5851838a: Get-PxcGateway now verifies applicable TCP LISTEN ownership against the already validated process before returning the fixed HTTP endpoint. Denied, malformed, mismatched and conflicting records fail closed. Native PS5.1/7 tests reproduce the old wrong-owner dummy-key wire leak and pass the new positive/negative controls. Independent exact-head review3 verified the entire finding class closed: https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/issues/1279#issuecomment-6720089491 . Snapshot/query-to-send race limits remain explicit; no atomic ownership claim or real deployment activation.

@codex review

Review exact head b75d9e4e61e5fd16aa9d4870f5fa844fb6029766 (P1-S2 #1279) while this PR remains draft. Inspect all three files and security/spec behavior. Frozen r3 spec and retained native/Linux evidence: https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/tree/dcc38a4357e9b306e9b1bc64cadfe055c8231678/ops/checkpoints/wp1279-r3/gates-b75d9e4 . Prior F01/F02 are closed by independent CLI review2; original verdict https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/issues/1279#issuecomment-6718663536 . Your review is a separate promotion gate. No Windows CI or live activation.
